flows.title: Invite a team member
steps: Open the dashboard, click Settings, and select Team.

Enter the team member's details and choose the lowest access level the person needs: Read-only, which can view but not create or update anything, Read-write or Administrator. Each person gets their own user, so permissions are set per person.
Click Invite team member. GoCardless emails the person an invitation, and they finish joining from its link.
